y0: He touched the man with leprosy
y1: A man with leprosy came to Jesus and bowed down: “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
y2: No one touched people with leprosy. But Jesus reached out His hand and touched him: “I want to. Be clean!” Instantly the man was healed.
y4: A centurion of the Roman army came and said, “My servant is very sick.” Jesus said, “I will come and heal him.”
y5: The centurion said, “I am not worthy for you to come to my house. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.” Jesus was amazed at his faith, and the servant was healed that very hour.
y7: Jesus came to Peter's house. Peter's mother-in-law was lying in bed with a fever.
y8: When Jesus touched her hand, the fever left her. She got up and served Jesus. In the evening, many sick people came and were healed.
y10: When Jesus and His disciples were going in a boat, a great storm came up. The waves were covering the boat, but Jesus was sleeping.
y11: The disciples woke Him up and cried out, “Lord, save us!” When Jesus rebuked the wind and the sea, everything became completely calm. The disciples were amazed: “What kind of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey Him?”
verse: “What kind of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey Him?”
prayer: Jesus, I praise You for touching the sick and calming the storm with just one word. Help me to believe that You are with me when I am afraid and in trouble. Let me be someone who believes in Your word like the centurion did. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: leprosy. A scary disease that hurts the skin. Back then, a person with leprosy had to live alone outside the village. Jesus touched the man with leprosy.
d1: centurion. A commander in charge of one hundred Roman soldiers. The centurion believed in Jesus' words.
d2: faith. A heart that believes and trusts in God. Jesus was amazed at the centurion's faith.
d3: fever. An illness where the body gets very hot. Peter's mother-in-law was lying in bed with a fever.
d4: storm. Very strong winds and big waves. A great storm came up on the sea.
d5: rebuke. To give a strong command saying “stop!” to something wrong. Jesus rebuked the wind and the sea.
